upstream_api_review.spec_delta_from_previous_binding: Additive over 0.9.0-rc.23 (streamix_server#256, adult version names): the client subset stays at 118 operations and the full specification at 387, with no operation or parameter added or removed; apart from info.version both exports change the same nine places. New schema VersionDisplay (additionalProperties false; required text, 1..160 characters in the schema, with the server producing at most 40 characters and 40 columns; basis code|title|technical|ordinal; nullable code and family, set when basis is code; tags, up to 32 machine names in display order; rules_version, YYYY.MM.patch). Version and BestVersion gain the required nullable member display (VersionDisplay or null): a server-built short name for versions of persisted adult origin, derived from the normalized code in the file name, its tags and the technical differences among the versions of the same work and episode, falling back to a short title, the technical facts and an ordinal, never the whole file name; ordinary versions return null and keep their client-built labels. Capabilities features gain the required version_display (const true). The descriptions of GET /media/{id}/versions and GET /media/{id}/versions/{version_id} add the adult order (Chinese subtitles first, then leak > uncensored > decensored > AI decensored, then resolution, then bitrate; the parts of one variant together in part order; episode groups keep the place of their first entry; pages of an adult work are cut from that order, and works with more than 2000 versions keep the quality order) and display on the version detail; BestVersion.display states that the best version of an adult work is the first entry of its adult order. BestVersion keeps additionalProperties false, so validators bound to the RC23 schema reject RC24 BestVersion objects. In OPERATIONS.json only typed_sdk_schema_sha256.Version changes; the fields the typed SDK reads are unchanged and display stays in Version.extra. The url 2.5.9 dependency update (RUSTSEC-2026-0592) in the same server release changes neither specification.
